positive.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to include in the image.

negative.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to exclude from the image.

denoise.tooltip: The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling.

LoraLoaderModelOnly.name: LoraLoaderModelOnly
LoraLoaderModelOnly.description: This LoRAs loader is used to modify the diffusion model, altering the way in which latents are denoised such as applying styles. Multiple LoRA nodes can be linked together.

resize_type.tooltip: Select how to resize: by exact dimensions, scale factor, matching another image, etc.

width.tooltip: Target width in pixels. Set to 0 to auto-calculate from height while preserving aspect ratio.

height.tooltip: Target height in pixels. Set to 0 to auto-calculate from width while preserving aspect ratio.

crop.tooltip: How to handle aspect ratio mismatch: 'disabled' stretches to fit, 'center' crops to maintain aspect ratio.

multiplier.tooltip: Scale factor (e.g., 2.0 doubles size, 0.5 halves size).

longer_size.tooltip: The longer edge will be resized to this value. Aspect ratio is preserved.

shorter_size.tooltip: The shorter edge will be resized to this value. Aspect ratio is preserved.

width.tooltip: Target width in pixels. Height auto-adjusts to preserve aspect ratio.

height.tooltip: Target height in pixels. Width auto-adjusts to preserve aspect ratio.

megapixels.tooltip: Target total megapixels (e.g., 1.0 ≈ 1024×1024). Aspect ratio is preserved.

match.tooltip: Resize input to match the dimensions of this reference image or mask.

crop.tooltip: How to handle aspect ratio mismatch: 'disabled' stretches to fit, 'center' crops to maintain aspect ratio.

multiple.tooltip: Resize so width and height are divisible by this number. Useful for latent alignment (e.g., 8 or 64).

scale_method.tooltip: Interpolation algorithm. 'area' is best for downscaling, 'lanczos' for upscaling, 'nearest-exact' for pixel art.

ResizeImageMaskNode.name: ResizeImageMaskNode
ResizeImageMaskNode.description: Resize an image or mask using various scaling methods.

MaskPreview.name: MaskPreview
MaskPreview.description: Preview the masks without saving them to the ComfyUI output directory.

attention.tooltip: The dense attention backend. Comfy Kitchen attention uses quantized INT8 attention and is available only on Nvidia and AMD GPUs.

output_tooltips: The model with the selected attention backend.
ModelAttentionBackend.name: ModelAttentionBackend
ModelAttentionBackend.description: Selects the dense attention implementation for the model. When used with Block Sparse Attention, this backend is used whenever sparse attention is inactive or unsupported.

filename_prefix.tooltip: The prefix for the file to save. May include formatting tokens such as %date:yyyy-MM-dd% or %Empty Latent Image.width%.

format.tooltip: The file format in which to save the image.

input_color_space.tooltip:
Colorspace of the input tensor. The EXR is always written as scene-linear in the matching gamut.
sRGB — input is sRGB-encoded Rec.709; the inverse sRGB EOTF is applied.
HDR — input is HLG-encoded Rec.2020 (BT.2100); the inverse HLG OETF is applied to get scene-linear light.
linear — input is already scene-linear (Rec.709 primaries); written through unchanged. Use this for renderer/compositor output.

bit_depth.tooltip: Auto uses 8-bit YUV420 for sRGB and 10-bit YUV420 for HDR.

input_color_space.tooltip: Colorspace of the input images. HDR selects BT.2020/HLG and HDR PQ selects BT.2020/PQ.

crf.tooltip: Lower values produce higher quality and larger files.

loop_count.tooltip: Number of times to loop the animation. 0 loops forever.

SaveImageAdvanced.name: SaveImageAdvanced
SaveImageAdvanced.description: Saves the input images to your ComfyUI output directory.

ImageStitch.name: ImageStitch
ImageStitch.description:
Stitches image2 to image1 in the specified direction.
If image2 is not provided, returns image1 unchanged.
Optional spacing can be added between images.

GetImageSize.name: GetImageSize
GetImageSize.description: Returns the width, height, and batch size of the image.

width.tooltip: Width of the canvas and the pixel grid for the bounding boxes.

height.tooltip: Height of the canvas and the pixel grid for the bounding boxes.

editor_state.tooltip: Draw bounding boxes and set each box type, text, description, color palette. Start with background element first and foreground last.

background.tooltip: Optional image used as background in the canvas and preview.

bboxes.tooltip: Bounding boxes, elements, or a JSON string to initialize the canvas. A new upstream value initializes the canvas; edits made on the canvas take priority and are kept until the upstream value changes again.

last_incoming.tooltip: Internal state managed by the canvas: the upstream bboxes value that last initialized it. Leave empty to re-initialize the canvas from the bboxes input on the next run.

CreateBoundingBoxes.name: CreateBoundingBoxes
CreateBoundingBoxes.description: Draw bounding boxes in a canvas. Outputs Ideogram prompt elements, pixel-space bounding boxes, and a preview image.

element.tooltip: Prompt elements from the node Create Bounding Boxes.

high_level_description.tooltip: Optional description of the image in one or two sentences. Strongly recommended.

background.tooltip: Mandatory description of the image background or environment.

photo.tooltip: Camera or lens details for photographic outputs (e.g. 35mm, f/1.4, bokeh).

art_style.tooltip: Art style description (e.g. flat vector illustration, bold outlines).

aesthetics.tooltip: Mandatory aesthetic keywords (e.g. moody, cinematic, desaturated).

lighting.tooltip: Mandatory lighting description (e.g. golden hour, rim light, dramatic shadows).

medium.tooltip: Mandatory medium type (e.g. photograph, illustration, 3d_render, painting, graphic_design). When style = photo, set to photograph.

color_palette.tooltip: Hex color codes that steer the image's dominant colors. Up to 16 entries.

BuildJsonPromptIdeogram.name: BuildJsonPromptIdeogram
BuildJsonPromptIdeogram.description: Build a JSON prompt for the Ideogram 4 model.

s_noise.tooltip: Per-step noise multiplier at the first step (1.0 = match training).

s_noise_end.tooltip: Per-step noise multiplier at the last step. Set equal to s_noise for a constant schedule.

noise_clip_std.tooltip: Clamp per-step noise to +/- N*std. 0 disables.

SamplerLCM.name: SamplerLCM
SamplerLCM.description: LCM sampler with tunable per-step noise. s_noise is a multiplier on the model's training noise scale

FluxKontextImageScale.name: FluxKontextImageScale
FluxKontextImageScale.description: This node resizes the image to one that is more optimal for flux kontext.

model.tooltip: The model to use KV Cache on.

output_tooltips: The patched model with KV Cache enabled.
FluxKVCache.name: FluxKVCache
FluxKVCache.description: Enables KV Cache optimization for reference images on Flux family models.

ref_pad_image.tooltip: Fills the padding frames of the image conditioning with this image instead of gray, anchoring identity without pinning frames (SVI-style anti-drift padding, used by models such as ID-V2V).

pre_cfg.tooltip: If true, rescale the combined noise BEFORE the sampler's CFG combine, without clamping (can amplify). Matches the norm-scaled CFG used by models like Lens. Default false keeps the original post-CFG x0-space attenuate-only behavior.

PreviewAny.name: PreviewAny
PreviewAny.description: Preview any input value as text.

StringFormat.name: StringFormat
StringFormat.description: Same as Python's string format method. Supports all of Python's format options and features.

dotall.tooltip: When enabled, the dot (.) character will match any character including newline characters. When disabled, dots won't match newlines.

count.tooltip: Maximum number of replacements to make. Set to 0 to replace all occurrences (default). Set to 1 to replace only the first match, 2 for the first two matches, etc.

RegexReplace.name: RegexReplace
RegexReplace.description: Find and replace text using regex patterns.

indent.tooltip: Spaces per indent level. 0 produces compact single-line string.
Spaces per indent level. 0 produces compact single-line string.

ReferenceLatent.description: This node sets the guiding latent for an edit model. If the model supports it you can chain multiple to set multiple reference images.

resolution.tooltip: Reference images are resized to about resolution x resolution pixels, at multiples of 32, preserving aspect ratio. 0 keeps each reference at its own size, rounded to a multiple of 32.

images.tooltip: Reference images, seen by the text encoder and spliced into the sequence as VAE latents.

output_tooltips: Empty latent on the first reference image's size, to match with sampling as any other size shifts the edit.
TextEncodeQwenImage21.name: TextEncodeQwenImage21

device.tooltip: auto uses spare VRAM, then RAM. cpu (RAM) is prefetched behind compute and costs little speed. off recomputes the prefix every step, which is slower but is the one way to rule the cache out.

dtype.tooltip: Storage precision. default is lossless. int8 halves the cache at about bf16 accuracy, int4 quarters it but roughly doubles the per-step error.

QwenImage21Cache.name: QwenImage21Cache
QwenImage21Cache.description: Allows setting the KV cache device and quantization, by default the model uses the auto -option. Quantization potentially speeds up edit workflows when memory starved

images.tooltip: Optional reference images, seen by the text encoder and appended to the latent sequence as clean frames. Later images are resized to the first one, and the sampled latent should match its size.

vae.tooltip: Without a VAE the images only condition the text encoder through the vision tower.

images.tooltip: Reference image(s) to edit. All references are resized to the output resolution before encoding.

width.tooltip: Output width. 0 = use the first reference image's size.

height.tooltip: Output height. 0 = use the first reference image's size.

TextEncodeMageFlowEdit.name: TextEncodeMageFlowEdit
TextEncodeMageFlowEdit.description: Encode an edit instruction with one or more reference images for Mage-Flow-Edit. Reference latents are resized to the output resolution (width/height, or the first image's size when 0). Use the latent output for sampling so the sizes always match.

images.tooltip: Reference image(s) to edit. Boogu focuses on one reference per sample; more are allowed.

ScaleROPE.name: ScaleROPE
ScaleROPE.description: Scale and shift the ROPE of the model.

ImageCompare.name: ImageCompare
ImageCompare.description: Compares two images side by side with a slider.

video.tooltip: Video frames as image batch. Assumed to be 24 FPS; subsampled to 1 FPS internally.

thinking.tooltip: Operate in thinking mode if the model supports it.

use_default_template.tooltip: Use the built in system prompt/template if the model has one.

mtp.tooltip: Speculative decoding with the checkpoint's multi-token-prediction head. No effect without MTP weights. auto adapts the draft depth; 2-5 pins it. Sampled output stays correctly distributed but differs from non-MTP output for the same seed.

system_prompt.tooltip: Replaces the system prompt in the model's chat template. Ignored when the default template is not used.

image.tooltip: Optional base image to paint over

num_iterations.tooltip: Number of times to execute the loop body.

start_iteration_index.tooltip: Index of the first iteration when using For loop mode.

max_iteration.tooltip: The exclusive stopping value for iteration_index in For mode.

step.tooltip: The index step size between each iteration when using For loop mode.

list.tooltip: List of items the loop iterates on. The loop body executes once per item.

cache_iterations.tooltip: Reuse unchanged iteration results from previous executions. Disable to execute every iteration again.

parent_iteration.tooltip: Connect iteration_index from an outer Start Loop to nest this loop.

initial_iteration_value.tooltip: Value exposed as current_iteration_value on the first iteration.

output_tooltips: Index of the current loop iteration.
True during the first iteration of the loop.
True during the last iteration of the loop.
Current item from the list when using List mode. None in Simple and For modes.
Loop-carried value for the current iteration: initial_iteration_value on the first iteration, then next_iteration_value from End Loop on each subsequent iteration.
StartLoop.name: StartLoop

accumulate.tooltip: Return output_value from every iteration when enabled; otherwise return only the final iteration.

output_value.tooltip: Value returned by End Loop. It returns the final iteration or all iterations according to accumulate.

next_iteration_value.tooltip: Value sent from End Loop back to Start Loop for the next iteration.

terminations.tooltip: Connect outputs that must execute on every iteration. Their values are not returned.

termination.tooltip: Connect a preview or side-effect output that must execute on every iteration. Its value is not returned.

output_tooltips: The final iteration's output_value, or values accumulated across iterations when accumulate is enabled.
